phase_readback.provenance: Black Glass reports retained private actor/log observations. Aero has independently checked endpoint values in the portable capsule but has not received the actor/log bodies. Treat the phase values as reported readback, not independently rehashed raw observations.
phase_readback.inference: Most of the observed A/A difference lies between engine-initialised and first-render observation. Capture attempts correlate with that interval but do not prove OCR, rendering, CPU, cache, thermal, power or background-process cause. Factorio log time and actor QPC time use different origins; segment arithmetic assumes comparable elapsed origins and requires raw launch-bracket/log review.

known_controls.player_data_policy: One prepared seed initializes a shared ordinary-menu write-data root before the cohort. Live player-data changes between runs; do not describe the mutable runtime state as identical or silently reset it in a replacement acceptance run.
known_controls.argument_hash_limit: Per-run output/config paths differ. Equal preserved settings and selection do not imply identical argument hashes.
known_controls.memory_limit: Both pilots were admitted without wait with about16.5GiB free. Coarse admission/owned-process peaks do not identify background CPU, GPU, disk or thermal activity.
